thread:
mike: Quick coordination thread  Meridian Systems wants a turnkey "Edge Connector" bundle: LangChain orchestration -> LlamaIndex retrieval -> our gateway -> Dedicated. They also asked for an OrchX plugin and a marketplace tile. Who can pick this up?

sara: I can take the LangChain + LlamaIndex wiring and test the sample notebooks. Question: will Meridian send ingestion jobs multi-tenant via OrchX or one tenant per job? That affects namespacing. ETA: Tue EOD for a smoke summary.

devon: Ill own the gateway adapter and OrchX shim. Quick note: OrchX uses synchronous task callbacks; shim should ack immediately and fan-out to our /v1/stream endpoint. Ill prototype the shim and add retry with exponential backoff.

leila: Ops note: Meridian staging uses a custom cert chain; ops-bot please file a cert acceptance ticket. We may need a reverse-proxy for demo if they can't rotate certs. Also propose a 90-minute maintenance window to push a gateway toggle for tenant namespacing: Wed 01:30-03:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Created PARTNER-9001: "Meridian cert bundle + edge connector shim" assigned to @leila and @devon.

sara: Found a vector-store key collision risk when concurrent ingestion runs target the same shared store. Proposed test patch to namespace keys by tenant: ```python
# tenant-aware vector key for LlamaIndex
def lindex_key(tenant_id, doc_hash):
    return f"meridian:{tenant_id}:lindex:{doc_hash}"
```

devon: Nice. Ill add a gateway flag to toggle namespacing and include a small feature to rewrite keys during migration. Also will add a canary rollout and smoke checks. Maintenance window stands.

mike: Marketing/legal: we wont list in cloud marketplaces until the co-marketing addendum is signed. Legal-bot please open COANN-5010 and flag turnaround. Marketing can start drafting the tile copy in parallel.

legal-bot: COANN-5010 created and assigned to @mike for initial partner info. Typical review 48-72 hours.

leila: Ops rollback plan: if error rate > 0.8% or p95 spikes > 2x in 5 mins post-deploy, revert gateway config and shift traffic to fallback model for 10 minutes. Ill publish the runbook once infra confirms the window.

sara: Also add a streaming tool-call test with LangChain so we validate tool invocation + streaming stability. Quick dev curl: ```bash
curl -N -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_DEV" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-stream-1","input":"call tool:extract_entities"}'
```

devon: Ill include an OrchX demo script that shows the shim acknowledging and streaming a retrieval result back to the OrchX task. Will push the repo link and deploy checklist by Tue morning.

mike: Action owners recap: Sara -> LangChain/LlamaIndex tests & namespacing patch; Devon -> OrchX shim + gateway flag + deploy checklist; Leila -> cert ticket + maintenance scheduling + rollback runbook; Mike -> partner coordination + marketplace asset prep; Legal-bot -> COANN-5010.

leila: Ops will standby during the maintenance window and perform the post-deploy health probes (p50/p95 latency, error rate, token drop checks). Ill also prepare a short postmortem template if anything regresses.

mike: Thanks all. Keep updates short and post blockers here. If legal needs more info, ping me and Ill loop in Meridian PM. :white_check_mark:
